name: AgriGov
description: AgriGov is a curated, trilingual (English-Hindi-Marathi) dataset designed to address the scarcity of domain-grounded multilingual resources for agricultural policies and farmer welfare schemes. Initially, we collected and structured data from 50 government schemes sourced from trusted portals using automated scraping techniques, organizing it into predefined semantic fields (e.g., title, eligibility, application process, documents, exclusions).
